walk.generatorNote: belly generator glow centre per frame [x,y] (null = hidden); use for the phase-2 red glow overlay

gatling.muzzleNote: muzzle [x,y] in frame pixels (just past the barrel tip), frames 0-3 = gun still rising (null); fire loop = frames 5-8

lit.note: front facing the flash (face, chest, belly, front thigh, far arm, barrel top) lit amber, only the back shaded. Show while a muzzle flash is visible, the normal frame between shots.

gatling.portNote: ejection port on top of the gun drum (user-marked), frames 4-8; casings start here

shots.rule: one fire-loop frame = one shot. On every shot, at the same game frame: show the lit body frame, draw ONE muzzle flash and spawn ONE casing. Never spawn a casing without a flash or a flash without a casing.

slam.timingNote: windup: loop frames 2-3 slowly during the aim/telegraph time; dash: 4-7 once, hold 7 while charging
slam.source: video (Scenario) + pixelation, front boot of frames 4-7 redrawn from frame 0

stomp.timingNote: lift 0-5 slow (hold 4-5), 6 fast, 7 impact: shockwave + screen shake + squash, 8-11 settle
stomp.source: video (Scenario): circled slam-video frame -> user stomp image, pixelated on the walk scale; dust removed
stomp.footNote: floor point under the stomping (front) foot in stomp frames 07-11; put the stomp FX origin here

phase.timingNote: play once; 2-3 is the reactor burst (good moment for a flash/shake); switch to p2_walk after frame 12
phase.source: video (Scenario): tear pose -> phase-2 walk image, pixelated; loose shreds removed

p2_walk.generatorNote: white-hot core centre per frame [x,y]; phase-2 red glow overlay anchor
p2_walk.source: 1P walk frames with generator, barrel heat and coat tears copied 1:1 from phase frame 12, aligned per body part

fx_boss_muzzle.note: anchor = muzzle point (left edge, barrel centre). Place anchor on gatling.muzzle; pick a random frame per shot, show 1-2 game frames each. Facing left: flip X.

fx_boss_muzzle_glow.note: halo behind/around the flash, centred on the muzzle; normal or ADD blend, same timing as the flash

fx_boss_stomp.layout: grid 8 columns, left to right then top to bottom
fx_boss_stomp.note: phase 1. Dimmer palette (user: lower the brightness). Draw 1:1 (do not apply boss scale); origin on stomp.footImpact; start on stomp.impactFrame (7). Source pixelfx impacts/ground-slam (MIT).

fx_boss_casing.note: one casing per shot; row = variation (pick at random). Put "start" on gatling.port (the casing leaves the ejection port there); origin is the floor point below it. Flip X when facing left. Same for phase 1 and 2. Source: tools/art/pixelfx/basili-casing.js (pixelfx, MIT)

fx_boss_stomp_p2.note: phase 2: the dim effect at 120 px wide. First copy on stomp.footImpact, second 70 px further forward (facing direction; mirror to -70 when facing left) and 3 fx frames (0.2 s) later, so the shock travels forward. Draw 1:1, no boss scale.

p2_gatling.source: phase-1 gatling repainted with phase-variant-transfer (key frame from the approved phase-2 walk pair)
p2_gatling.portNote: ejection port on top of the gun drum (user-marked), frames 4-8; casings start here

shots.rule: one fire-loop frame = one shot. On every shot, at the same game frame: show the lit body frame, draw ONE muzzle flash and spawn ONE casing. Never spawn a casing without a flash or a flash without a casing.

call.note: index finger up, two small circles, arm down; guards appear on frame 9 (end of the circles)
